_comment: The pinned versions of the comma parts (docs/comma-pack-format.md). 'starpilot': the public StarPilot source Mapd's generator is built from (mapd.py setup). 'go': the Go toolchain Mapd's go.mod asks for; mapd.py setup downloads go.dev's archive for the machine (go<version>.<platform>.tar.gz) and installs it only when its size and SHA-256 are the ones pinned here per platform; a platform without a pin is refused (bytes and sha256 as go.dev's download list, https://go.dev/dl/?mode=json&include=all, gives them, read once on 2026-11-22; the list is not read at setup). 'engines': the pyvalhalla wheels comma.json offers (catalog.py): bytes, sha256 and blake2b_256 as PyPI's JSON (https://pypi.org/pypi/pyvalhalla/3.9.1/json) gives them, read on 2026-11-22. PyPI's url of a file is files.pythonhosted.org/packages/<b[:2]>/<b[2:4]>/<b[4:]>/<file>, b its blake2b_256, and catalog.py writes it that way: the url itself is not written here because the packs repository's privacy scan refuses a 60-digit hex run.
